analysis.visual_description: On the tables. The tables on the bed. The three lines are in. The red bundle is still apart and knotted. One candle. He reads them and does not add a fourth.
On the tables. The stylus lies in the gutter. No death. No title. No sum under the three lines. The window is black.
On the tables. A thumb on the cover. The three lines still show. The bundle is untouched.
